FallenMC | Non-Toxic Bedrock Semi-Vanilla SMP

Vanilla at its core. Custom everywhere else.

FallenMC is a Bedrock SMP built around a friendly community and over 200 custom-coded features. Build, trade, explore and compete, with no pay-to-win. Everything is earned in-game.

Connect

IP: 168.119.88.183

Port: 7024

Play on PC, mobile, console, or anything that runs Minecraft Bedrock.

What makes FallenMC different

🔹 An economy you control

Run your own player shop, sell on the auction house, take jobs, collect bounties and climb the leaderboards.

🔹 RPG progression

Unlock skills, abilities and a full skill tree, then specialise your playstyle. Custom OP enchants add endgame goals worth chasing.

🔹 Protect what you build

Claim your land with a simple shovel claim system, team up with friends, and toggle PvP when you want it. Item loss protection keeps a bad death from ruining your day.

🔹 A world worth exploring

Custom world generation, ancient ruins, new plants and flower variants, and capturable mobs via Safarinet. Decorate your base with collectible plushies.

🔹 Events that keep things fresh

Every hour, rare crates appear somewhere in the overworld. Reach them first and take the rewards. We also run regular events and tournaments with prizes, plus a PvP arena for those who like a challenge.

🔹 Quality of life

Homes, TPA, random teleport, kits, a live armour and offhand durability display, and a chat link between Minecraft and our Discord.

Meet Combrocoro, our custom AI

Not your typical bot. 

Combrocoro is goofy, helpful, and surprisingly clever. Ask in chat and it will guide new players, play minigames (Rock Paper Scissors, Trivia, Guess the Number, Hide & Seek), and even heal you or refill your hunger. Treat it well and it rewards you. Treat it badly and it will haunt you.
